# WentoCart

> Self-hosted, open-source commerce. Laravel and React. Licensed under OSL-3.0.

- Website: https://wentocart.com
- Documentation: https://wentocart.com/documentation
- Download: https://wentocart.com/download
- Marketplace: https://marketplace.wentocart.com
- Source: this repository

## For developers

- Install from source: see `README.md` and `docs/INSTALL.md`
- Shop GraphQL: `POST /api/v1/graphql`
- Admin GraphQL: `POST /api/v1/console/graphql`
- Live operation index on a running shop: `GET /api/v1/llms.txt`
- OpenAPI: `GET /api/v1/store/docs` and `GET /api/v1/console/docs`

This repository ships the Classic theme and the Main Menu extension. Other modules are installed from the marketplace.
